source_row.item_data_json: {"options":{"A":"Apply continuous suction while inserting and withdrawing the suction catheter","B":"Advance the catheter deeply while applying continuous suction during insertion","C":"Apply intermittent suction during withdrawal, keep each pass brief, and reassess","D":"Perform only one suction pass even when secretions remain after reassessment"}}
source_row.rationale: Correct oral suctioning technique involves applying suction intermittently, primarily during catheter withdrawal, limiting each pass to a brief duration to minimize mucosal trauma and hypoxia, and reassessing the client's respiratory status and secretion clearance between passes, repeating as needed.
source_row.source_detail: Apply suction intermittently during withdrawal; limit suction pass to 10–15 seconds and reassess; accessed 2026-08-14.
